id: title:adamleithp:deprecate the side panel info tab

review.posthog_relevance: Replaces the Info tab's local state and default tab calculation with a dedicated side panel state, supporting the migration of the Info tab to a new navigation structure.
review.reason: The chunk removes dependency on the old `sceneLayoutLogic` and its state, replacing it with the new `sidePanelLogic` and its values. It also adds support for deprecated tabs and their placement, including a warning banner for the Info tab. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the implementation of the new `sidePanelLogic` or the definition of `FEATURE_FLAGS.TODAY_RAIL_NAV`, nor does it show the complete removal of the old `sceneLayoutLogic` and its associated state.
